summary: This bill directs the President to remove U.S. armed forces from Iran within 60 days of the start of "Operation Epic Fury" and complete a phased withdrawal within 30 days thereafter, as required by the War Powers Resolution, unless Congress authorizes continued military action.

scores.thoughts: This bill directly addresses the use of United States Armed Forces in a specific operation and mandates their withdrawal, which inherently impacts military operations and resource allocation, thus affecting military spending by reducing the scope of an ongoing operation.
